verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own pages say users can ask Copilot questions about public and private repos and open a new pull request 'all in natural language' (docs-6). They also document starting Copilot agent tasks from the app (docs-3, docs-14) and assigning issues to Copilot, then refining its work through comments (docs-5). Together these show natural-language operation of core workflows inside the app. missing for 10: evidence that natural language covers broader app operation such as triage, navigation, notifications and merging; in-depth first-party mobile docs beyond marketing copy; independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile Copilot experience.
